94: def loss_total(row, stage, arm):
95:     if stage not in (1, 2) or any(row.get(k) != v for k, v in method.metadata(arm).items()):
96:         raise ValueError("Wrong stage or update identity")
97:     total = 0.
98:     def close(a, b):
99:         if not np.isfinite(a) or not np.isfinite(b) or not np.isclose(a, b, atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-6):
100:             raise ValueError("Positive-rank loss decomposition differs")
101:     for role, weight in (("current", 1.), ("history", .1)):
102:         if role == "history" and stage == 1:
103:             if role in row: raise ValueError("Stage A cannot use history")
104:             continue
105:         r = row[role]
106:         if r["qualification_old_rank"] is not False or r["mse1"] is not None or len(r["views"]) != 2:
107:             raise ValueError("Wrong rank/teacher/views in formal update")
108:         if role == "current" and r["mse0"] != 0:
109:             raise ValueError("Current used a birth teacher")
110:         for v in r["views"]:
111:             close(v["rank_used"], v["rank_pos"])
112:             close(v["total"], v["bce"]+v["rank_pos"]+.5*v["hard"])
113:         close(r["supervised"], sum(v["total"] for v in r["views"])/2)
114:         close(r["distillation"], r["mse0"])
115:         close(r["supervised_contribution"], weight*r["supervised"])
116:         close(r["teacher_contribution"], .5*r["mse0"])
117:         contribution = weight*r["supervised"]+.5*r["mse0"]
118:         close(r["weighted"], contribution)
119:         total += contribution
120:     close(row["total"], total)
121:     return total

124: def validate_diagnostic(d, arm):

126:         raise ValueError("Diagnostic scoring/training identity differs")

129: def native_objective_pair(off, on, stage):
130:     arm = on["training"]["arm"]
131:     loss_total(on, stage, arm)
132:     if any(off.get(k) != v for k, v in method.metadata(arm).items()):
133:         raise ValueError("Native control identity differs")
134:     details = {}
135:     for role in (("current",) if stage == 1 else ("current", "history")):
136:         a, b = off[role], on[role]
137:         if a["qualification_old_rank"] is not True or b["qualification_old_rank"] is not False:
138:             raise ValueError("Wrong old/new rank switch")
139:         for key in ("mse0", "mse1", "assignment_sha256", "teacher_contribution"):
140:             if a[key] != b[key]: raise ValueError("Rank comparison changed teacher/allocation")
141:         for va, vb in zip(a["views"], b["views"], strict=True):
142:             for key in ("bce", "hard", "rank_pos"):
143:                 if va[key] != vb[key]: raise ValueError("Rank comparison changed other terms")
144:             if not np.isclose(va["total"], va["bce"]+va["rank_used"]+.5*va["hard"], atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-6):
145:                 raise ValueError("Old-rank control arithmetic differs")
146:         details[role] = dict(old_rank=[v["rank_used"] for v in a["views"]],
147:             new_rank=[v["rank_pos"] for v in b["views"]], old_weighted=a["weighted"],new_weighted=b["weighted"],
148:             actual_total_difference=b["weighted"]-a["weighted"], scalar_difference_is_not_effect_gate=True)
149:     return details

152: class Budget(single.Budget):

154:         super().__init__(root)
155:         self.limits = policy()["runtime"]

158: def projection(measurements):
159:     arms = {arm: single.projection(measurements[arm]) for arm in method.ARMS}
160:     seconds = sum(p["projected_total_seconds"] for p in arms.values())
161:     peak = math.ceil(1.1*(max(m["W_F"] for m in measurements.values())+
162:                            sum(2*m["W_I"] for m in measurements.values())+2*2**30))
163:     return dict(arms=arms, projected_total_seconds=seconds, projected_peak_output_bytes=peak,
164:                 within_budget=seconds <= 57600 and peak <= 16*2**30)

167: def reviewed_gate(path, kind):
168:     gate = data.read_json(path)
169:     if (kind not in ("NATIVE", "FORMAL") or gate.get("kind") != kind
170:             or gate.get("status") != "APPROVED_NO_OPEN_BLOCKERS" or gate.get("source_files") != sources()
171:             or gate.get("candidates") != policy()["candidates"]
172:             or gate.get("implementation_authorization") != data.record(AUTHORIZATION, data.ROOT)):
173:         raise ValueError("Source-bound positive-rank implementation gate required")
174:     # Implementation approval is not GPU/data permission. The future permission is a separate exact record.
175:     permission = data.read_json(data.verify(data.ROOT/gate["execution_authorization"]["path"], gate["execution_authorization"]))
176:     if (permission.get("status") != "APPROVED" or kind not in permission.get("stages", [])
177:             or permission.get("contract") != data.record(CONTRACT, data.ROOT)
178:             or permission.get("source_files") != sources() or not permission.get("user_quote")):
179:         raise ValueError("Specific execution approval missing")
180:     for key in ("external_review", "primary_disposition", "cpu"):
181:         data.verify(data.ROOT/gate[key]["path"], gate[key])
182:     cpu = data.read_json(data.ROOT/gate["cpu"]["path"])
183:     if (cpu.get("status") != "PASS_HANDWRITTEN_ONLY" or cpu.get("mode") != "cpu"
184:             or cpu.get("source_files") != sources() or cpu.get("cumulative_charged_seconds", math.inf) > 300
185:             or cpu.get("unresolved_checks") != [] or set(cpu.get("qualified_tests", [])) != set(CPU_TESTS)):
186:         raise ValueError("Affected CPU evidence missing")
187:     return gate

190: def validate_gate(job, path):
191:     gate = reviewed_gate(path, "FORMAL")
192:     if (gate.get("job") != job.relative_to(data.ROOT).as_posix() or gate.get("runtime") != policy()["runtime"]
193:             or gate.get("supervision") != policy()["supervision"]):
194:         raise ValueError("Dual formal scope differs")
195:     gpu = data.read_json(data.verify(data.ROOT/gate["gpu"]["path"], gate["gpu"]))
196:     if (gpu.get("status") != "PASS_HANDWRITTEN_ONLY" or gpu.get("mode") != "gpu"
197:             or gpu.get("source_files") != sources() or gpu.get("cumulative_charged_seconds", math.inf) > 1200
198:             or set(gpu.get("arms", {})) != set(method.ARMS)):
199:         raise ValueError("Both native candidates must qualify")
200:     for arm, native in gpu["arms"].items():
201:         if (native.get("actual_updates") != 6 or native.get("charged_seconds", math.inf) > 600
202:                 or native.get("maximum_records") != 224 or native.get("channel_tokens") != 256
203:                 or native.get("both_phases_encoder_head_effect") is not True
204:                 or native.get("next_update_bitwise_equal") is not True
205:                 or native.get("pooling_restores_verified") is not True
206:                 or native.get("rank_precision_verified") is not True
207:                 or native.get("metadata") != method.metadata(arm)):
208:             raise ValueError("Native effects/restoration missing: "+arm)
209:     if not projection({arm: v["measurements"] for arm, v in gpu["arms"].items()})["within_budget"]:
210:         raise ValueError("Measured dual run exceeds budget")
211:     return gate

25: def native_preflight(continuing: bool = False) -> dict:
26:     if not continuing:
27:         return preflight()
28:     # The completed first arm leaves a CUDA context, but no live model/state may survive.
29:     gc.collect()
30:     torch.cuda.synchronize()
31:     torch._C._cuda_clearCublasWorkspaces()
32:     torch.cuda.empty_cache()
33:     if torch.cuda.memory_allocated() or torch.cuda.memory_reserved():
34:         raise ValueError("Previous arm still owns live/reserved CUDA tensors")
35:     process = psutil.Process()
36:     if (os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "0" or len(process.cpu_affinity()) != 1
37:             or any(os.environ.get(k) != "1" for k in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"))
38:             or os.environ.get("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM") != "false"):
39:         raise ValueError("Physical GPU0 and pre-import single-thread environment required")
40:     gpu = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--id=0", "--query-gpu=index,uuid,memory.total,memory.free,memory.used",
41:                                    "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], text=True).strip()
42:     apps = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--id=0", "--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory",
43:                                     "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], text=True).strip()
44:     foreign_apps = [line for line in apps.splitlines() if int(line.split(",", 1)[0].strip()) != process.pid]
45:     ancestors = {process.pid, *(p.pid for p in process.parents())}
46:     jobs = [p.info for p in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "username", "cmdline"])
47:             if p.pid not in ancestors and any("step28" in x for x in (p.info["cmdline"] or []))]
48:     available = psutil.virtual_memory().available
49:     if int(gpu.split(",")[-2]) < 30*1024 or available < 72*2**30 or foreign_apps or jobs:
50:         raise ValueError(f"Continuation resource gate failed: gpu={gpu}, apps={apps}, host={available}, jobs={jobs}")
51:     return {"gpu": gpu, "compute_apps": apps, "host_available_bytes": available, "project_jobs": jobs,
52:             "allowed_context_pid": process.pid, "live_allocated_bytes": 0, "reserved_bytes": 0}

55: def native(check, progress, handwritten, out, arm, *, continuing=False):
56:     method = run.method
57:     active, control = arm, arm+"_old_rank"

83:     probes = {"encoder":model.encoder[0].auto_model.encoder.layer[0].attention.self.query.weight,"head":model.head[0].weight}
84:     gradients, effects, table_checks, objective_pairs = {}, {}, [], {}
85:     def updated(arm, phase, step, h=None, target=None):
86:         if len(updates)>=6: raise ValueError("Six actual native calls exhausted")
87:         pre = {}

194:     inference_path=work/"H_inference.pt";infer_meta=metadata("Actual candidate inference restore fixture")
195:     infer=timed("s_I",lambda:native_save(inference_path,model,None,infer_meta,check));identities["inference"]=infer
196:     if timed("r_I",lambda:run.restore_point(inference_path,infer,model,None,active))!=infer_meta:
197:         raise ValueError("Inference H metadata restore mismatch")
198:     with diag.neutral(model):
199:         if not np.array_equal(before_scores,timed("v",lambda:method.restored_score(model,[history],c,check))):
200:             raise ValueError("Inference H scores not bitwise restored")
201:     measurements["W_F"]=max(common_path.stat().st_size,paired_path.stat().st_size)
202:     measurements["W_I"]=inference_path.stat().st_size
203:     data.write_json(out/"temporary_checkpoint_identity.json",dict(files=identities,removed=False))
204:     for path in (common_path,paired_path,inference_path):path.unlink()
205:     work.rmdir();data.write_json(out/"temporary_checkpoint_identity.json",dict(files=identities,removed=True))
206:     return dict(resources=resources,numerics=numerics,pretrained_archive=archive,initial_state=initial,
207:         actual_updates=6,updates=updates,measurements=measurements,projection=run.single.projection(measurements),effects=effects,
208:         both_phases_encoder_head_effect=True,pooling_restores_verified=True,next_update_bitwise_equal=True,
209:         metadata=method.metadata(active), rank_precision_verified=bool(table_checks),
210:         table_precision=table_checks, objective_pairs=objective_pairs,
211:         equality_counts=equality,maximum_records=224,channel_tokens=256,memory_bytes=len(payload),residuals=residuals,
212:         fixture="Six actual updates only. Common model/moments after call1; paired counter336 explicitly synthetic. Calls5/6 differ only by actual capture. No formal input.")

214: def main():
215:     import importlib
216:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
217:     parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("cpu", "gpu"))
218:     parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
219:     parser.add_argument("--gate", type=Path)
220:     parser.add_argument("--tests", nargs="*")
221:     parser.add_argument("--prior-seconds", type=float, default=0.)
222:     args = parser.parse_args()
223:     args.output = args.output.resolve()
224:     if os.name != "posix" or args.output.exists() or args.prior_seconds < 0:
225:         parser.error("Linux, new evidence and cumulative ledger required; GPU has no automatic retry")
226:     args.output.mkdir(parents=True)
227:     sys.path.insert(0, str(data.ROOT/"tests"))
228:     handwritten = importlib.import_module("test_step28_positive_ranking")
229:     os.environ["G_HALF_TEST_ROOT"] = str(args.output)
230:     os.environ["H_CONS_TEST_ROOT"] = str(args.output)
231:     torch.set_num_threads(1)
232:     torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
233:     numerics = run.parent.configure_numerics()
234:     process = psutil.Process()
235:     limits = run.policy()["cpu_verification" if args.mode == "cpu" else "native_verification"]
236:     report = {"status": "RUNNING", "mode": args.mode, "scope": "S_pos_H_pos_increment", "source_files": run.sources(), "formal_inputs": False, "torch": torch.__version__,
237:         "formal_labels": False, "prior_compute_seconds": args.prior_seconds, "peak_rss_bytes": 0, "peak_work_bytes": 0, "numerics": numerics}
238:     stopped, lock = threading.Event(), threading.RLock()
239:     arm_started = None
240:     def write():
241:         with lock:
242:             report["elapsed_seconds"] = time.monotonic()-STARTED
243:             report["cumulative_seconds"] = args.prior_seconds+report["elapsed_seconds"]
244:             report["cumulative_charged_seconds"] = args.prior_seconds+math.ceil(report["elapsed_seconds"])
245:             if "prior_actual_updates" in report:
246:                 report["cumulative_actual_updates"] = report["prior_actual_updates"]+report.get("actual_updates", 0)
247:             if args.mode == "gpu" and torch.cuda.is_initialized():
248:                 report["max_reserved_bytes"] = torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved()
249:             data.write_json(args.output/"result.json", report)
250:     def check(reserve=0):
251:         report["peak_rss_bytes"] = max(report["peak_rss_bytes"], process.memory_info().rss)
252:         total, evidence = 0, 0
253:         for path in args.output.parent.rglob("*"):
254:             try:
255:                 if path.is_file():
256:                     size = path.stat().st_size
257:                     total += size
258:                     if "work" not in path.relative_to(args.output.parent).parts:
259:                         evidence += size
260:             except FileNotFoundError:
261:                 pass
262:         report["peak_work_bytes"] = max(report["peak_work_bytes"], total)
263:         disk_reserve(args.output, total, reserve, limits.get("maximum_work_bytes", limits["maximum_evidence_bytes"]))
264:         if (time.monotonic()-STARTED+args.prior_seconds > limits["maximum_seconds"]
265:                 or (arm_started is not None and time.monotonic()-arm_started > limits["per_arm_maximum_seconds"])
266:                 or evidence > limits["maximum_evidence_bytes"] or total > limits.get("maximum_work_bytes", limits["maximum_evidence_bytes"])
267:                 or report["peak_rss_bytes"] > limits["maximum_rss_bytes"]
268:                 or (args.mode == "gpu" and torch.cuda.is_initialized() and torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved() > 28*2**30)):
269:             raise RuntimeError("Approved cumulative qualification budget exceeded")
270:     def watchdog():
271:         while not stopped.wait(.5):
272:             try:
273:                 check()
274:             except BaseException as exc:
275:                 report.update(status="BUDGET_STOP", error=str(exc))
276:                 write()
277:                 os._exit(2)
278:     def progress(stage, **details):
279:         report.update(stage=stage, **details)
280:         write()
281:     watcher = threading.Thread(target=watchdog, daemon=True)
282:     watcher.start()
283:     try:
284:         if (len(process.cpu_affinity()) != 1 or any(os.environ.get(k) != "1" for k in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"))
285:                 or os.environ.get("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM") != "false"):
286:             raise ValueError("Pre-import single CPU/thread environment required")
287:         if args.prior_seconds < limits["prior_charged_seconds"]:
288:             raise ValueError("Prior charged budget cannot be reset")
289:         if args.mode == "cpu":
290:             if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "":
291:                 raise ValueError("CPU qualification must disable GPU")
292:             test_class = handwritten.PositiveRankingTests
293:             selected = args.tests or unittest.defaultTestLoader.getTestCaseNames(test_class)
294:             report["selected_tests"] = selected
295:             suite = unittest.TestSuite(test_class(name) for name in selected)
296:             with (args.output/"unittest.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
297:                 result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2, failfast=True).run(suite)
298:             report.update(tests_run=result.testsRun, failures=len(result.failures), errors=len(result.errors), skipped=len(result.skipped))
299:             if not result.wasSuccessful() or result.skipped:
300:                 raise RuntimeError("Affected handwritten qualification failed")
301:         else:
302:             if args.gate is None:
303:                 raise ValueError("Implementation review gate required")
304:             gate = run.reviewed_gate(args.gate, "NATIVE")
305:             if args.prior_seconds != 0:
306:                 raise ValueError("Unique dual native attempt; no automatic retry")
307:             report["arms"] = {}
308:             for arm in method.ARMS:
309:                 arm_started = time.monotonic()
310:                 arm_out = args.output/arm
311:                 arm_out.mkdir()
312:                 def arm_check(reserve=0):
313:                     check(reserve)
314:                     if time.monotonic()-arm_started > limits["per_arm_maximum_seconds"]:
315:                         raise RuntimeError("Per-arm native budget exceeded")
316:                 def arm_progress(stage, **details):
317:                     if "actual_updates" in details:
318:                         details["active_arm_actual_updates"] = details["actual_updates"]
319:                         details["actual_updates"] += sum(v["actual_updates"] for v in report["arms"].values())
320:                     progress(stage, active_arm=arm, **details)
321:                 value = native(arm_check, arm_progress, handwritten, arm_out, arm,
322:                                continuing=bool(report["arms"]))
323:                 arm_check()
324:                 value["charged_seconds"] = math.ceil(time.monotonic()-arm_started)
325:                 report["arms"][arm] = value
326:                 arm_started = None
327:                 write()
328:             report["actual_updates"] = sum(v["actual_updates"] for v in report["arms"].values())
329:         check()
330:         report["status"] = "PASS_HANDWRITTEN_ONLY"
331:         if args.mode == "cpu":
332:             report.update(qualified_tests=selected, unresolved_checks=[])
333:     except BaseException as exc:
334:         report.update(status="FAIL", traceback=traceback.format_exc())
335:         raise
336:     finally:
337:         stopped.set()
338:         watcher.join(timeout=2)
339:         write()
340: 
341: if __name__ == "__main__":
342:     main()
